game: NEON TIDE — open-world crime in Port Solano

shots.caption: COVER — Night neon downtown police chase at 5 stars: PSPD cruisers ramming, AIR-1 helicopter spotlight on the Tide GT, mission card, police response panel, weapon slots and speedometer on the HUD.
Sunset beachfront cruise in the Tide GT along the palm boardwalk, street-race mission active, DRIFT popup, radio station and minimap visible.
Harbor heist at the Port Vault in daylight: Deke on foot in a firefight with vault guards, mission marker, Vex dialog portrait and 2-star wanted level.
Downtown night escape in the armored Vault Truck at 4 stars: roadblock ahead, AIR-1 helicopter overhead, mission card tracking the getaway to the garage.
